content:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty ALERT fired (P1) — high 5xx rate on inference-gateway-us-east1. Trigger: gateway.5xx_rate > 5% over 2m. Affected routes: /v1/generate (spike), /v1/chat (small). PD incident: PD-48921.

alex-oncall: acked — taking oncall. seeing ~8% 5xx on grafana: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/ingress?from=now-15m&to=now

sre-jen: noted. pinging canary and LB teams. first step: confirm if this is steady error type (502 vs 504 vs 500).

eng-maya: logs show a lot of 502 + "upstream reset while reading response header" from edge-proxy. sample: ```2026-03-15T02:17:12Z ERROR proxy.go:138 upstream reset for backend=kvcache-01 conn=... status=502```

ops-ryan: i'm seeing increased connection resets on the keepalive pool between gateway and model-hosts. Might be short-lived overload on dedicated pools. Also autoscaler has recent scale-down at 02:10.

alex-oncall: actions: 1) hold traffic to new canary (if any) 2) temporarily bump pool capacity 3) switch fallback model-route if necessary. can someone confirm active canary?

eng-maya: canary rollout for v2-llama was paused yesterday. no new canary traffic. so not rollout-related.

sre-jen: doing a quick capacity bump for us-east1 dedicated pool: ```infractl clusters scale --region us-east1 --pool inference-dedicated --delta +3``` issuing now.

pagerbot: autopager update: PD escalation to SRE leads in 2m if unacked by lead.

ops-ryan: i pushed the scale command — nodes coming up. also increasing proxy keepalive timeout to reduce resets as a stopgap: ```kubectl -n infra set env configmap/proxy PROXY_KEEPALIVE=90s```

alex-oncall: thanks. @product-lina can you check customer-facing queues for any incoming tickets? want to surface impact proactively.

product-lina: checking Zendesk queues — one slowdown ticket from customer "Acme Payments" reporting intermittent 502s since 02:12. tagging CSM. I'll prepare a brief to send to affected P0 customers if this persists.

eng-maya: after scale and timeout bump, the 5xx rate dropped to ~2.1% but still occasional spikes. traces show many failures during long requests >20s where model-hosts OOM or restart. grabbing kube events.```kubectl get pods -n model-hosts -o wide | grep crash```

sre-jen: quick mitigation: enable routing to fallback smaller-quantized model variant to reduce memory pressure for requests >15s. Command: ```routectl set-weight --route /v1/generate --model rdl-4q8b --weight 30``` Doing now.

pagerbot: PD update: escalation to SRE leads triggered (SRE leads paged).

alex-oncall: if fallback helps, we'll keep it for 20m and monitor quality regression. ops, please keep autoscaler paused for another 10m to avoid thrash.

ops-ryan: autoscaler paused: ```infractl autoscaler pause --region us-east1 --duration 10m --reason "incident PD-48921"```

eng-maya: fallback routing reduced 5xx to ~0.6% and tail latency improved. however logs show an outlier host (model-host-12) with repeated oom_kill. marking for drain.

sre-jen: draining host: ```kubectl drain model-host-12 -n model-hosts --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data``` then cordon. will monitor cluster.

product-lina: drafted customer note for affected accounts. sending to ops for review. short message: "We've observed intermittent 5xx errors for inference endpoints in us-east1; mitigation in progress; reduced capacity may affect latency temporarily. We'll follow up with root cause."

alex-oncall: handoff plan: i'll keep incident active for another 30m while we stabilize, then hand to next oncall @eng-maya at 03:00 UTC. please add any lingering actions to the PD incident.

ops-ryan: host drained, replacement pod scheduled. memory pressure seems reduced. keeping an eye on cache warmups — we should expect slight latency bump as KV caches refill.

eng-maya: adding runbook snippets for postmortem: ```- track scale events between 02:00-02:20
- list OOM'd pods and images
- evaluate kernel OOM logs on model-hosts
- check recent model changes/quantization flags```

pagerbot: PD update: PD incident PD-48921 status=mitigated -> monitoring.

alex-oncall: summary: cause likely model-host memory pressure causing upstream resets and 5xx. mitigations: scaled pool, increased keepalive, routed portion of traffic to smaller model variant, drained oom host. impact: short-lived 5xx spike (~8% -> <1%), some tail latency increase during recovery. next: full RCA and postmortem doc, confirm autoscaler and routes restored, follow up with affected customers. I'll close in 30m if stable. :white_check_mark: 

eng-maya: adding note to the incident ticket with pod IDs and OOM logs.

product-lina: notified CSMs and queued customer emails if we need them.

alex-oncall: handing off to @eng-maya for monitoring at 03:00 UTC. tagging oncall rotation. thanks all. :pray:
